selected_work: R82 conservative F20 fixed-function translation/readiness classifier.
summary: Added a bounded readiness classifier for R81-observed fixed-function state. It accepts only SELECTARG1/SELECTARG2/MODULATE with unmodified DIFFUSE/CURRENT/TEXTURE arguments, passthrough texcoords 0..7, disabled texture transforms, point/linear min-mag filters, none/point/linear mip filters and wrap/clamp addressing. Disabled stage chains, unsupported operations/args, generated texcoords, texture transforms, unsupported filters/addresses and active stages >=2 fail closed. Runtime census records readiness mask/active stages and ready/pending counters. No shader generation or native draw activation was added.
evidence: CONVERSION-DX11-00020 completed all-eight-stage/sampler observation and selected a conservative F20 translation/readiness model as the next bounded action.
Current resource exactness observes source texture descriptors only on stages 0 and 1, so R82 deliberately marks active stages >=2 unsupported instead of overclaiming readiness.

changes.result: Added FixedFunctionStageState, explicit FixedFunctionUnsupported reason bits and FixedFunctionTranslationReadiness API.
Implemented conservative fixed-function readiness classification with stage-chain, operation/argument, texcoord, transform, sampler and resource-stage fail-closed gates.
Reused shared stage state, classified R82 readiness, hashed/logged reason mask and active-stage count, and added ready/pending counters.
Added R82 summary/signature compatibility and fixedFunctionReadinessReady/Pending parsing; pending contributes to unsupported evidence.
Added R82 regression fixture for stage-2 resource-coverage fail-closed evidence.
Added structural guards for the readiness API, conservative supported subset, runtime use and analyzer evidence.

activation_gate.reason: R82 is readiness classification only. It emits no fixed-function shader and active stage >=2 remains unsupported until texture resource exactness expands. Programmable F21 translation, live mirror ownership and exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity also remain prerequisites.

next_action: Keep NativeDrawPathActivationAllowed=false and shaderTranslationExact=false. In the next bounded DX11 task, either extend texture resource exactness/descriptor observation beyond stages 0/1 so R82 can safely classify additional active fixed-function stages, or separately prototype fixed-function shader generation consuming only R82-ready states. Do not combine either task with F21 programmable shader translation. Exact-build Quest3/VDXR parity remains mandatory before native draw promotion.
